scripts.lint: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: bun run build:native && CURIOSITY_RUNTIME_NATIVE_PROFILE=development bun test tests/*.test.ts && CURIOSITY_RUNTIME_NATIVE_PROFILE=development bun test tests/characterization/*.test.ts
scripts.test:network-denied: CURIOSITY_RUNTIME_NATIVE_PROFILE=development sandbox-exec -p '(version 1)(allow default)(deny network*)' bun test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.verify: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo build --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --locked && bun run check-types && CURIOSITY_RUNTIME_NATIVE_PROFILE=development bun test tests/*.test.ts && CURIOSITY_RUNTIME_NATIVE_PROFILE=development bun test tests/characterization/*.test.ts
